title: REQ · Fallback test reads the particles call arguments with a typed mock
summary: bootSceneFallback reads particles call index 2 without TS2493
description: Context: bootSceneFallback.test.ts line 89 reads particles.mock.calls[0][2] from an untyped vi.fn(). Desired behavior: effectContext passes the resolved key as third argument to scene.add.particles and the test types the mock signature. Expected result: no TS2493 and the fallback assertion still holds.
acceptance_criteria: Given a dust effect with an unknown asset, when createEffect runs, then particles receives the fallback key as third argument
Given the typed mock, when tsc runs, then calls[0][2] compiles with no TS2493
technical_constraints: Phaser 3.90 particles(x, y, texture, config) signature
